resources.string: Current temperature and weather for your location

1. Tap Activate Glyph Toy and add "Weather".
2. Go to Settings › Glyph Interface › Flip to Glyph › Always-on Glyph Toy and choose Weather.
3. Put the phone face down.

The matrix shows the temperature for 30 seconds, then an animated weather icon for 3 seconds. The weather refreshes every 30 minutes. Opening this app also updates your location.
Location permission is needed to know where you are.
